profiles.shortDescription: M-I SWACO is an SLB brand for drilling-fluid and solids-control technologies. Its documented scope includes drilling and completion fluids, shakers, screens, centrifuges and related fluid-processing systems.
fullDescription: SLB's official legacy-company page identifies M-I SWACO as part of its well-construction portfolio following the 2010 acquisition.

The current official product scope covers drilling and completion fluids together with solids-control equipment such as shale shakers, screens, mud cleaners and centrifuges for drilling, mining and water-well operations.

profiles.shortDescription: Miba develops and manufactures functional components for energy-efficient drive systems. Its product areas include sintered components, engine and industrial bearings, friction materials, power electronics and engineered coatings.
fullDescription: Miba's official product-area directory presents an Austrian industrial group focused on components that support power transmission and energy conversion.
The documented portfolio spans powder-metal parts, engine and industrial bearings, friction materials, power-electronics components and coatings for mobility, energy and industrial applications.

profiles.shortDescription: MICO is a ZF off-highway brand for hydraulic braking and control components. Its portfolio includes brakes, master cylinders, hydraulic valves, actuators and related control systems for mobile machinery.
fullDescription: MICO's official company profile identifies the current business as ZF Off-Highway Solutions Minnesota and preserves MICO as the product brand.
The official catalog range covers hydraulic and electrohydraulic brakes, master cylinders, valves, actuators, pressure controls and engineered braking systems for off-highway equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Micro-Epsilon develops precision sensors and measurement systems for displacement, distance, position, temperature and dimensional inspection. Its portfolio spans capacitive, inductive, laser, confocal and optical measurement technologies.
fullDescription: Micro-Epsilon's official product directory documents sensors and systems for high-precision industrial measurement and inspection.
The range includes displacement and distance sensors, laser scanners, 2D and 3D measurement systems, infrared temperature measurement, colour sensors and automated dimensional-inspection solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Micronor develops fiber-optic and electromechanical sensors for position, motion, force, temperature and safety monitoring. Its products include encoders, accelerometers, force sensors, microswitches and geared position transducers.
fullDescription: Micronor's official site documents fiber-optic sensing products for electrically noisy, high-voltage and hazardous environments alongside electromechanical motion-control components.
The portfolio includes absolute and incremental encoders, temperature and acceleration sensors, force measurement, emergency-stop and microswitch products, cam timers and motorized potentiometers.

profiles.shortDescription: MicroStep develops CNC cutting machines and production software for metal fabrication. Its systems support plasma, oxyfuel, laser and waterjet cutting of sheets, pipes, profiles and formed components.
fullDescription: MicroStep's official product directory presents CNC machinery for 2D and 3D cutting, drilling and processing of metallic materials.
The portfolio includes plasma, oxyfuel, laser and waterjet systems, pipe and profile cutting, dome processing, automated material handling and CAM, nesting and production-management software.

profiles.shortDescription: MIKROMAT manufactures ultra-precision machine tools for boring, milling and jig grinding. Its range includes vertical and horizontal machining centers and application-specific precision machines.
fullDescription: MIKROMAT's official product site documents machine tools for jig boring, milling, grinding and ultra-precision machining.
The published range covers vertical and horizontal machining centers, coordinate boring and milling machines, jig grinders and engineered systems for demanding component geometries.

profiles.shortDescription: Mikron develops production systems for high-precision manufacturing. Its businesses cover machining systems, cutting tools and automated assembly and testing solutions.
fullDescription: Mikron's official corporate site presents a Swiss industrial group organised around Machining Solutions and Automation divisions.
The product scope includes high-performance machining centers, cutting tools and custom assembly, testing and production systems for high-volume precision manufacturing.

profiles.shortDescription: Milltronics manufactures CNC machine tools and controls for milling and turning. Its portfolio includes toolroom machines, vertical machining centers, CNC lathes and bridge mills.
fullDescription: Milltronics' official site identifies a United States manufacturer of CNC machines and the INSPIRE+ control platform.
The published machine range covers toolroom mills and lathes, vertical machining centers, slant-bed CNC lathes and bridge mills for general and precision metalworking.

profiles.shortDescription: Minco designs and manufactures temperature sensors, flexible heaters, flex circuits and related instruments. These components can be combined into integrated thermal and sensing assemblies for industrial applications.
fullDescription: Minco's official product directory documents four core technology areas: temperature sensing, flexible heating, flex-circuit fabrication and instrumentation.
The company also engineers integrated components and assemblies that combine sensing, heating and interconnection functions for compact and demanding equipment designs.

profiles.shortDescription: Minebea is a MinebeaMitsumi brand associated with precision mechanical and electromechanical components. The current official group portfolio includes bearings, motors, fans, sensors, actuators and related electronic components.
fullDescription: MinebeaMitsumi's official brand and product pages preserve Minebea as a current group brand while documenting the broader combined company portfolio.
The supported industrial scope includes miniature and precision bearings, electric motors, fans and blowers, load and force sensors, linear actuators and connectivity components.

profiles.shortDescription: Mini Motor manufactures compact electric motors, gearmotors and integrated motion-control products. Its range covers AC, DC and brushless motors, planetary and worm gearboxes, drives and format-change actuators.
fullDescription: Mini Motor's official site documents compact motion products designed for packaging, food, conveying and automated machinery.

The portfolio includes asynchronous, direct-current and brushless motors, stainless-steel and washdown gearmotors, planetary and worm gearboxes, integrated drives and programmable rotary and linear actuators.

profiles.shortDescription: Minimax develops fire-detection, alarm and suppression systems for industrial and infrastructure applications. Its solutions include sprinkler, water-mist, gas and special-hazard extinguishing systems.
fullDescription: Minimax's official site documents integrated fire-protection technologies from detection and control through extinguishing and system service.

The range covers fire alarm and detection, sprinkler and deluge systems, high-pressure water mist, gaseous suppression, foam and special-hazard systems for industrial plants, data centers, logistics and marine applications.

profiles.shortDescription: MISUMI manufactures and supplies configurable components for factory automation and precision die and mould production. Its own-brand scope includes mechanical, motion, positioning and tooling components used in equipment design.
fullDescription: MISUMI's official business overview distinguishes the company's manufacturing activity in factory-automation components and precision die and mould parts from its distribution operations.

The documented product scope includes configurable mechanical components, linear-motion and positioning parts, fasteners, frames, tooling and precision components for automated machinery and manufacturing equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Mitsuboshi Belting manufactures power-transmission and conveyor belts and related engineered materials. Its industrial range includes V-belts, timing belts, pulleys, couplings and conveyor-belt systems.
fullDescription: Mitsuboshi Belting's official corporate profile identifies a Japanese manufacturer founded in 1919.

The published portfolio covers industrial and automotive transmission belts, conveyor belts and systems, pulleys and couplings, engineering plastics, waterproofing materials and electronic and coating materials.

profiles.shortDescription: Mitsui Seiki manufactures high-precision machine tools for machining, boring and grinding. Its range includes horizontal and vertical machining centers, jig borers, jig grinders and thread grinders.
fullDescription: Mitsui Seiki's official product site documents high-precision machine tools manufactured through the group's Japanese production operations.

The portfolio covers multi-axis horizontal and vertical machining centers, jig boring machines, jig and thread grinders and application-specific systems for aerospace, mould, compressor and precision-component work.

profiles.shortDescription: Mitutoyo manufactures dimensional-metrology instruments and systems. Its portfolio includes handheld measuring tools, coordinate measuring machines, vision and form systems, sensors, encoders and hardness-test equipment.
fullDescription: Mitutoyo's official catalog presents a broad metrology portfolio for shop-floor, inspection-room and laboratory measurement.

The range includes calipers, micrometers and indicators, coordinate measuring machines, form and surface systems, optical and vision equipment, linear encoders, sensors, data-management tools and hardness testers.

profiles.shortDescription: MIURA manufactures boilers and associated factory utility equipment. Its business also covers water-treatment, food-processing, medical, marine and exhaust-gas equipment supported by maintenance systems.
fullDescription: MIURA's official business page identifies boilers and associated equipment as the group's core manufacturing activity.

The documented scope combines once-through and exhaust-gas boilers with water-treatment systems, food and medical equipment, marine machinery and energy and environmental support systems for industrial facilities.

profiles.officialName: MIXACO Dr. Herfeld GmbH & Co. KG
profiles.shortDescription: MIXACO designs and manufactures industrial mixers for powders, granulates and liquid-solid formulations. Its portfolio includes container, high-speed, heating and cooling, laboratory and continuous mixing systems.
fullDescription: MIXACO's official site documents German industrial mixing technology developed since 1965.

The product range covers container and double-cone mixers, high-speed and heating-cooling mixers, laboratory units and continuous systems for plastics, chemicals, powder coatings, food and other process applications.

profiles.shortDescription: MIXEL designs and manufactures standard and custom industrial agitators and mixing systems. Its range covers top-, side- and bottom-entry agitators, static mixers and hygienic or process-specific configurations.
fullDescription: MIXEL's official site identifies a French GMM Pfaudler group company focused on industrial agitation and mixing.

The documented portfolio includes custom and standard agitators for homogenisation, dissolution, suspension and storage, with solutions for chemical, pharmaceutical, food, cosmetic, environmental and mining processes.

profiles.shortDescription: MOBA develops mobile automation, machine-control and sensing systems for construction and material-handling equipment. Its products include grade control, 2D and 3D guidance, on-board weighing and thermal-analysis systems.
fullDescription: MOBA's official product site documents in-house development and manufacturing of sensors, controllers and machine-control systems for mobile equipment.
The published range covers paving grade and slope control, excavator guidance, compaction assistance, lasers, on-board scales, payload monitoring, thermal analysis and supporting software and cables.

profiles.shortDescription: Mobrey is an Emerson level-instrumentation brand used for robust point-level detection. Current official materials document float and displacer switches for liquid-level alarms, pump control and demanding process duties.
fullDescription: Emerson's official documentation identifies Mobrey as part of its level-measurement portfolio.
The documented Mobrey range centers on horizontal and vertical float and displacer switches for high- and low-level alarms, pump control, overfill prevention and power-generation applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Mogensen develops screening and sizing equipment for bulk solids. Its systems include multi-deck sizers, vibratory screens, feeders and optical sorting technologies for process industries.
fullDescription: Mogensen's official product material documents the MSizer family and related bulk-material processing equipment.

The supported portfolio covers multi-deck screening machines, vibratory sizing and feeding systems and sorting solutions used to classify minerals, chemicals, food ingredients and other dry bulk materials.

profiles.shortDescription: Moldow designs and manufactures industrial dust-extraction and filtration systems. Its product range includes bag and cartridge filters, separators, rotary valves, conveyors, fans and heat-recovery units.
fullDescription: Moldow's official site identifies a Danish manufacturer of dust extraction, filtration and industrial finishing systems.
The documented dust-extraction portfolio includes filters, cyclones and separators, rotary valves, chain and pneumatic conveyors, extraction fans, heat exchangers and energy-control systems.

profiles.shortDescription: MOLLET develops level measurement and point-level detection equipment for bulk solids and liquids. Its product families include rotary-paddle, vibrating, capacitive, membrane and continuous level instruments.
fullDescription: MOLLET's official technical documentation presents a level-instrumentation manufacturer for silos, vessels and process equipment.

The range covers limit switches and continuous measurement based on rotary-paddle, vibration, capacitive, membrane, radar and weight-and-cable technologies, together with pressure and safety accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: Mondomix is a Bühler equipment brand for mixing, aerating and processing bakery, confectionery and dairy masses. Its portfolio includes aerators, premixers, cookers, depositors, fat melters and heat exchangers.
fullDescription: Bühler's official product pages preserve Mondomix as a current food-processing equipment brand.

The documented range covers continuous aeration, batter and cream premixing, confectionery cooking, pressure-sensitive depositing, fat melting, buffering and scraped-surface heat exchange for bakery, confectionery and dairy production.

profiles.officialName: A. Monforts Textilmaschinen GmbH & Co. KG
profiles.shortDescription: Monforts develops and manufactures textile-finishing machinery. Its systems support stretching, drying, coating, dyeing and related continuous finishing processes for woven and technical textiles.
fullDescription: Monforts' official company page identifies a German textile-machinery manufacturer founded in 1884.
The documented technology scope centers on stenters, dryers, coating and dyeing systems and engineered finishing lines for conventional and technical textiles.

profiles.shortDescription: Mönninghoff develops and manufactures industrial drive components and engineered drive systems. Its portfolio includes clutches, shaft couplings, torque limiters, brakes and linear-motion products.
fullDescription: Mönninghoff's official product directory identifies a German drive-technology manufacturer founded in 1916.
The range covers electromagnetic and pneumatic clutches, torsionally stiff and flexible shaft couplings, overload limiters, holding brakes, linear technology and integrated system solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Montalvo manufactures web-tension control equipment for converting and continuous-material processes. Its range includes controllers, load cells, brakes, clutches, sensors, safety chucks and web-guiding components.
fullDescription: Montalvo's official product directory documents tension measurement and control components for unwinding, processing and rewinding continuous materials.

The portfolio includes closed- and open-loop controllers, load cells and amplifiers, pneumatic and magnetic brakes, clutches, torque sensors, rotary unions, safety chucks, spreader rolls and related automation systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Moore Industries manufactures signal-interface and process-control instrumentation. Its portfolio includes signal conditioners, isolators, temperature transmitters, sensors, alarm trips, gateways, displays and functional-safety instruments.
fullDescription: Moore Industries' official catalog documents rugged interface instruments for connecting field devices with PLC, DCS, SCADA and safety systems.

The product range covers signal transmitters, isolators and converters, temperature sensors and assemblies, HART and fieldbus interfaces, PID controllers, alarm trips, displays, power transducers and instrument enclosures.

profiles.shortDescription: Moretto manufactures auxiliary equipment and automation for plastics processing. Its systems cover material conveying, drying, dosing, granulation, temperature control, cooling, storage and plant supervision.
fullDescription: Moretto's official site identifies an Italian manufacturer of automated systems for plastics processing founded in 1980.

The product portfolio covers material conveying, drying and dehumidification, dosing and blending, grinding, mould-temperature control, chilling, storage and supervisory control for injection moulding, extrusion and recycling.

profiles.shortDescription: Moro designs and manufactures industrial fans for clean air, dust-laden air, fumes and process gases. Its range includes centrifugal, axial, anti-corrosion and roof-extraction fans.
fullDescription: Moro's official site identifies an Italian company that designs, manufactures and sells industrial fans.

The published product scope covers centrifugal and axial fans, corrosion-resistant constructions and roof extractors for ventilation, fumes, combustion gases and dusty-air handling under varied pressure and flow conditions.

profiles.shortDescription: Mössner develops and manufactures band-saw machines, foundry and aluminium-processing systems and special-purpose machinery. Its solutions also include automated handling, robotic machining, milling and inspection functions.
fullDescription: Mössner's official product directory documents German machinery for sawing, foundry processing, aluminium production and engineered automation.
The range includes standard and application-specific band saws, slab and billet sawing systems, special milling and marking equipment, robotic processing cells and turnkey special machines.

profiles.shortDescription: motan develops material-handling systems for plastics processing. Its portfolio covers storage, drying, dosing and mixing, conveying, controls and integrated raw-material management.
fullDescription: motan's official history documents a German equipment company founded in 1947 and focused on plastics material handling since the late 1970s.

The product range covers storage and material blanketing, dry-air drying, gravimetric and volumetric dosing, central conveying, loaders and integrated controls for injection moulding, extrusion, blow moulding and compounding.

profiles.shortDescription: Motive manufactures electric motors, gearboxes and electronic drive controls. Its range includes single- and three-phase motors, geared drives, variable-speed units and application-specific inverter systems.
fullDescription: Motive's official catalogs document an Italian power-transmission portfolio combining electric motors, mechanical gearboxes and electronic speed control.
The range covers IE-class three-phase and single-phase motors, brake and hazardous-area variants, worm, helical, bevel and parallel-shaft gearboxes, variators and integrated frequency-drive products.
